question: On 128 Pile rows at every position: how much do Γ's values change, and does the re-switching term's overlap with the update's own output change separate a fine-tune that learned nothing from the copy fine-tunes?

definitions.a: W0's input to the matrix, at every position (one choice per matrix: all four terms see the same vector)
definitions.g0, g1: Γ's value per position and subcomponent, on W0's and on W1's activations of the same row; released Γ, fp32, no autocast
definitions.E: δW a - (g1 C1 - g0 C0) a, from the whole masked change, not by subtraction of the shares
definitions.S_X: E<X, δW a> / E||δW a||^2, numerators and denominators summed over positions, then over the 24 matrices for the pooled reading
definitions.mean_abs_dg: E|g1 - g0| per subcomponent and position, over all 38,912 subcomponents pooled, and per matrix over its own

states.each: do-nothing (C1 = C0) and the least-squares split (split.split_state) of the same δW, read in one pass: same W1, same g1, so S_R is the same by construction
states.gaussian: iid normal per matrix, scaled per matrix so E||G a||^2 on these 128 rows equals ident32_s0's; seed 67; not saved, regenerated from the seed

thresholds.keep_code_max_source: Chosen here, no source: the advice's guess
thresholds.keep_copy_min_source: Chosen here, no source: the advice's guess
thresholds.drop_band_source: Chosen here, no source: the advice's guess
thresholds.tie_eps_source: So a tie, as filed inclusive, is not lost to float rounding
thresholds.size_rel_tol_source: Measured floor: ||rebuilt δW|| / filed rel_norm_max on h.3.mlp.down_proj is constant to 5e-6 relative over nine of E12 Amendment 1's ten students. rand32b_s1 reads 0.2% off on that matrix, presumably as its maximum is on another; that needs W0's norms, so stage a settles it, in its first minute. 20 x that floor
thresholds.size_ratio_tol_source: The table prints two decimals: half a unit in the last place, plus 0.001
thresholds.identity_tol_source: Measured floor on saved ident32_s0 with white a: identity miss 1.6e-7 per matrix, student factored against dense energy 1.3e-13. Real a are not white, so about 600 x the floor; the run prints the reading
thresholds.sum_tol_source: Measured floor on saved ident32_s0 with white a and stub gates: largest per-matrix |sum - 1| 2.8e-7. Real a are not white, so about 350 x the floor; the run prints the reading

verdict_rules.pair: For one code reading c and one copy reading s, S_R of do-nothing, in this order: |c - s| <= drop_band: drop. c > s: reversed. s < keep_copy_min or c > keep_code_max: between. c < -keep_code_max: code_negative. Else keep. Ties count as written (<=, >=), up to tie_eps
verdict_rules.overall: unreadable if any of the four pairs (code_step10 and code_step100, against ident32 s0 and s1) is, or a control stopped. Else the two code_step10 pairs decide: if they differ, seeds_disagree; else their common label, except a keep where either code_step100 pair is not keep, which is keep_at_step10_only
verdict_rules.why_step10_decides: ident32's fine-tunes are step 10, and the advice names code_step10; code_step100 can only take a keep back
verdict_rules.drop_both_small: A drop in which |c|, |s0| and |s1| are all <= keep_code_max is flagged: the read sees nothing on Pile rows, which is not the same as reading alike at a large value
verdict_rules.gaussian_like_copy: Beside the verdict, no change to it: |S_R(gaussian) - mean S_R(ident32)| <= drop_band

verdicts.keep: S_R(code) <= 0.1 and S_R(copy) >= 0.4 on both copy seeds, at both code steps. Next: a weight-side column for E62 and E58 is proposed to the user; unless gaussian_like_copy, which goes to the user first
verdicts.keep_at_step10_only: Keep at step 10, not at step 100. Next: not kept; the size dependence goes to the user with the numbers
verdicts.drop: S_R(code) within 0.15 of S_R(copy) on both seeds. Next: the idea goes to TRIED.md as dropped; the all-position reading of Γ's change stands by itself
verdicts.between: Neither: a gap over the band, but the code reading is above 0.1 or the copy reading below 0.4. Next: not adopted, no new run; the lead puts the numbers beside the noise floor and decides whether to raise it
verdicts.reversed: The learned-nothing fine-tune reads above the copy fine-tunes by more than the band. Next: as drop, and a loud report, since the advice's only hope for the read is the opposite order
verdicts.code_negative: A gap with the copy reading >= 0.4, but S_R(code) < -0.1: on a learned-nothing update the re-switching term opposes the update's change, which is a response, not a reading of nothing. The advice's bar is one-sided; this branch is added here. Next: not kept; goes to the user
verdicts.seeds_disagree: The two copy seeds give different labels against code_step10. Next: no verdict; the seeds' spread is the finding
verdicts.unreadable: A control stopped, or a reading is missing or not finite. Next: tell the lead; nothing is read

lean.verdict: drop, from the advice: R has no δW in it beyond Γ's response, and E36's code fine-tune moved the activations, which is all Γ needs. Low-medium: unmeasured
lean.gaussian: S_R(gaussian) below the copy fine-tunes: guess 0 to 0.2 against 0.2 to 0.6

W1 = W0.numerators: 0 exactly (algebra, and a repeated Γ pass being exact)

learned nothing, code_step10, code_step1.S_R: guess 0.2 to 0.6, not separable from copy
learned nothing, code_step10, code_step1.S_D: guess the same range as copy
learned nothing, code_step10, code_step1.mean_abs_dg: guess the same order as copy; no bar

rand32.S_R: guess 0.1 to 0.6: a reference with the same size of update as copy, read for its seed spread
rand32.mean_abs_dg: guess the same order as copy

control, every gate on.least squares: E||D a||^2 / E||δW a||^2 = 1 - omega - 2 cross + second

edge_cases.zero denominator: W1 = W0: den 0, every share None (weight_side.shares), checked by numerators; a None reading makes the verdict unreadable
edge_cases.ties: c = 0.1 and s = 0.4 keep; |c - s| = 0.15 drop (tests/test_weight_side.py)
edge_cases.negative shares: S_R is signed and has no ceiling at 1; s > 1 can keep; a large negative c is code_negative; both negative and apart is between
edge_cases.a gap, code above copy: reversed, a case the advice's two rules leave open
edge_cases.a gap, code under -0.1: code_negative, a case the advice's bar would call keep
edge_cases.step 100 against step 10: only a keep can move, to keep_at_step10_only

departures_from_the_advice: The student's size ratios (0.87 to 1.35) are Frobenius rel_norm_max, the largest ||δW||/||W|| in each state, often on different matrices, not an input-weighted E||δW a||^2. The advice's 'full term reproduces them' cannot hold. Replaced by: the Frobenius ratio from the saved offsets reproduces the table, and with every gate on, on real a, a student's own δW gives S_D = 1

1 - omega_act is not what a g = 1 direct term reads: the exact form adds -2 cross + second, computed in `weight_side.split_identity`. Exact to the rounding floor, so no tolerance has to absorb the cross term
S_E is computed from the whole masked change, so the shares' sum is a check and not a definition
Bars one-sided in the advice gain reversed and code_negative; between fills the gap
